function fromObject<T extends number | undefined>(fallback: T) {
  const { x = fallback }: { x?: number } = {};
  const y: number = x;
  return y;
}
function fromTuple<U extends number | undefined, T extends U>(fallback: T) {
  const [x = fallback]: [number?] = [];
  const y: number = x;
  return y;
}
function fromParameter<T extends string | undefined>(fallback: T, x: string | undefined = fallback) {
  const y: string = x;
  return y;
}
function fromUnconstrained<T>(fallback: T) {
  const { x = fallback }: { x?: number } = {};
  return x;
}
function fromUnknown(fallback: unknown) {
  const { x = fallback }: { x?: number } = {};
  return x;
}
function fromVoid(fallback: void) {
  const { x = fallback }: { x?: number } = {};
  return x;
}
console.log(fromObject(1), fromTuple(2), fromParameter("p"), fromUnconstrained(3), fromUnknown(4), fromVoid());
